gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.grotguh: Rarity: Only deep in the caves of the Guhmension
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.grotguh: A deep pink guh with tiny crystal specks in its fur that twinkle softly in the dark. Lives under the wool, most of all in the Glitter Cavern. See something twinkling in a cave? Chances are it's a Cave Guh, njeg! Tame it with cheese nibbles.
